verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents several first-party programmatic surfaces on its Gateway: an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint, an HTTP endpoint for invoking a single tool directly, HTTP hooks that let an external service wake an agent or submit a turn, an A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC binding, and a Gateway WebSocket for remote clients. Together these let an external program drive the agent. However, the docs call the chat surface "small", and probes found no published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, so the full breadth of API coverage is unproven. missing for 10: machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), evidence the API covers the full product surface (config, sessions, agent management) rather than a small subset, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
